先分清：观测、推断、模型与示意: Distinguish observation, inference, models and diagrams
岩石样本与地震记录是证据；深部结构与古环境需要结合多种证据推断。这里的剖面、路径: Rock samples and seismic records are evidence; deep structure and ancient environments are inferred by combining evidence. Sections, paths and progress here are teaching illustrations. Oxygen budgets, seawater density and relative sunlight answer narrowly defined questions. They do not predict real earthquakes, ancient atmospheric oxygen or Earth's future climate.
